preconditions.description: The number of movements n is between 1 and 2·10^9 inclusive.
The final position of the ball x is between 0 and 2 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The initial position of the ball is one of the shells numbered 0, 1, or 2.

The initial position of the ball is determined by the final position x and the number of movements n. If n is even, the initial position is (x + 1) % 3. If n is odd, the initial position is (x - 1) % 3.
